trigger: a python parent directory (/usr/local/lib, or macOS /opt/homebrew/lib) holding more than 50,000 entries so a python3.N name falls past the listing cut
summary: The ChildLister in scan_python_targets ignores ListResult.truncated, so a partial parent listing yields a partial python root set while the answer stays supported/FULL with no token; the walk treats the same cut as dir_truncated and visits none of the entries. Fix: return nullopt when lr.truncated so the parent becomes a root and the walk reports dir_truncated.
classification_rationale: the answer presents an incomplete root set as complete

reviewed_at_sha: c4e36ac046432f096e16aa2f3496e1149ef98b9f (merge-base with origin/dev unresolved; range base 0c68ac5043833decce953e5cb3f45d173374d7d1)
trigger: a METADATA/PKG-INFO whose Name: or Version: header straddles byte 16384 and has no newline inside the 16 KiB read
summary: parse_python_metadata accepts a final header line cut at the 16 KiB read cap as complete: a 16,384-byte head ending 'Version: 1.2' of a file declaring 1.2.3.4.5 returns 1.2 with version_source metadata (verified with a std-only harness). Real tools write Name and Version as the first headers so the trigger is not reachable from real distributions; E6 cannot be proven so the derived band gates. Fix: when head.size() equals the cap, ignore a final line with no newline and fall back to the directory name.
classification_rationale: a truncated version is presented as read from metadata

summary: python and node open a candidate once; a candidate that fails to open or read becomes a row with size 0 and version_source unreadable (python: filename with no token) and the answer stays supported, not archive_changed as the YAML (lines 334, 449) and docs/user-manual/inventory.md:578 state, and unlike scan and native which record archive_changed and drop the row.
